# Misc
## Emergency Maintenance Access
[bold]Called by: Any two[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] members.
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] An emergency situation requires crew to be able to freely move through the station, such as during a loose engine or during war when Code Delta has been called.
Must be ended as soon as the situation is resolved.
[bold]Ended when:[/bold] The emergency no longer requires broad maintenance or external access.
[bold]Ended by:[/bold] Any [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] member.
## Station-Wide Emergency Access
[bold]Called by: Any two[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] members.
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] An emergency situation requires crew to be able to freely move through the station, such as during a loose engine or during war when Code Delta has been called.
Must be ended as soon as the situation is resolved.
[bold]Ended when:[/bold] The emergency has passed.
[bold]Ended by:[/bold] Any [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] member.

## Self-Destruct Codes
[bold]Called by: Any two of:[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], or [color=#2253b5]NanoTrasen Representative[/color] plus any one [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] member [bold]OR[/bold] [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] or [color=#2253b5]NanoTrasen Representative[/color] plus any three [color=#fcdf03]Command[/color] members, with [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color] approval.
[bold]Activation time:[/bold] 30 seconds.
[bold]Conditions:[/bold] A direct order from Central Command has been issued to destroy the station, or for instances when allowing the station to continue is more of a threat than it is worth.
[bold]One-time use per shift.[/bold]
